repo.description: A high-performance framework for training LLMs, VLMs, diffusion, and embodied models on NVIDIA GPUs and Kunlun XPUs.  Supports  Pi0.5, GR00T-N1.7, FastWAM, Cosmos3, DreamZero, DeepSeek-V4,  GLM-5.3, Kimi-K3 and more.
repo.name: LoongForge

detail.body:
## Change Summary

What changed?

- Align GR00T-N1.7 eval with official Isaac-GR00T:
    - The Qwen3-VL backbone now always takes the last decoder layer's pre-final-RMSNorm output as `backbone_features`, on both transformers 4.x and 5.x. Before this, the extra RMSNorm corrupted the actions the policy predicted.
    - The eval image pipeline now reads `letter_box_transform` from the checkpoint's processor config instead of hard-coding it.
  - Checkpoints now save a `processor_config.json` (training `data_cfg`) next to the weights, so eval can recover the data spec from the checkpoint alone.
  - SimplerEnv: split eval into Bridge and Fractal configs and scripts. Add the Fractal (Google Robot) task configs.
  - Docs: update the LIBERO tutorial. Add a SimplerEnv training/eval README with SFT scripts, modality/stats files, and result figures.

Which issue or requirement does this address?

  - GR00T-N1.7 eval accuracy on LIBERO and SimplerEnv (Bridge & Fractal) did not match the official results.

 Which modules are affected?

  - `loongforge/embodied/model/groot_n1_7`, `loongforge/embodied/eval` (adapters, orchestrator, runners, payload builder, factory), `loongforge/embodied/distributed/checkpoint.py`, `loongforge/embodied/data/.../groot_n1_7`, `configs/.../simplerenv`, `examples/embodied/groot_n1_7`

The evaluation results are as follows:

LIBERO

Success rates on the four suites (10 tasks × 20 episodes = 200 episodes per suite):

| Suite | Successful episodes | LoongForge | Official N1.7 |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| libero_spatial | 196 / 200 | 98.0% | 97.65% |
| libero_object | 197 / 200 | 98.5% | 98.45% |
| libero_goal | 193 / 200 | 96.5% | 97.5% |
| libero_10 (Long) | 191 / 200 | 95.5% | 94.35% |
| **Average** | **777 / 800** | **97.13%** | **96.99%** |

Bridge, 7 tasks:

| Task | LoongForge | Official N1.7 |
|---|:---:|:---:|
| widowx_open_drawer | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| widowx_close_drawer | 73.0% | 97.0% |
| widowx_spoon_on_towel | 86.0% | 78.0% |
| widowx_put_eggplant_in_basket | 83.0% | 53.0% |
| widowx_carrot_on_plate | 47.0% | 58.0% |
| widowx_stack_cube | 45.0% | 48.0% |
| widowx_put_eggplant_in_sink | 10.0% | 2.0% |
| **Average** | **63.5%** | **62.3%** |

Fractal, 6 tasks:

| Task | LoongForge | Official N1.7 |
|---|:---:|:---:|
| google_robot_pick_coke_can | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| google_robot_pick_object | 77.0% | 94.0% |
| google_robot_move_near | 100.0% | 100.0% |
| google_robot_open_drawer | 62.0% | 65.0% |
| google_robot_close_drawer | 88.0% | 69.0% |
| google_robot_place_in_closed_drawer | 6.0% | 7.0% |
| **Average** | **72.1%** | **72.5%** |

@@ -0,0 +1,313 @@
+# Quick Start: GR00T-N1.7 Training
+
+Using the four LIBERO suites as an example, this guide shows how to finetune **GR00T-N1.7** with LoongForge and evaluate the resulting checkpoints.
+
+- [1. Training Setup](#1-training-setup)
+- [2. Finetuning](#2-finetuning)
+- [3. Evaluation Setup](#3-evaluation-setup)
+- [4. Evaluation](#4-evaluation)
+
+---
+
+## 1. Training Setup
+
+### 1.1 Environment
+
+Following the LoongForge installation guide, pull the latest GPU image and start a container:
+
+```bash
+docker pull loongforge/loongforge:latest
+mkdir -p workspace
+docker run --gpus all --ipc=host -it --rm \
+  -v "$(pwd)/workspace:/workspace/data" \
+  -w /workspace/LoongForge \
+  loongforge/loongforge:latest bash
+```
+
+The image can train GR00T out of the box; no extra dependencies are required.
+
+### 1.2 Pretrained Weights
+
+Download the following weights from Hugging Face:
+
+| Weights | Purpose |
+|---|---|
+| [GR00T-N1.7-3B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B) | The pretrained weights actually used for finetuning |
+| [Cosmos-Reason2-2B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B) | Only provides the VLM backbone architecture and the tokenizer / processor |
+
+> **Note**: the Cosmos-Reason2-2B weights are overwritten by the GR00T-N1.7-3B weights after loading.
+
+### 1.3 Training Data
+
+The script uses the officially preprocessed datasets in LeRobot v2.1 format by default. To train on custom data, follow [NVIDIA Isaac-GR00T](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T) to preprocess it offline and convert the raw data into LeRobot v2.1 format first.
+
+LIBERO has four suites. The datasets are hosted under the IPEC-COMMUNITY organization on Hugging Face:
+
+| Suite | Focus | Dataset |
+|---|---|---|
+| Spatial | Spatial reasoning | [libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| Object | Object generalization | [libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| Goal | Goal-conditioned learning | [libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| 10 (Long) | Long-horizon multi-step tasks | [libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+
+Each dataset has the following layout:
+
+```text
+my_dataset/
+├── meta/
+│   ├── info.json          # dataset metadata
+│   ├── episodes.jsonl     # episode index and lengths
+│   ├── tasks.jsonl        # language task descriptions
+│   ├── stats.json         # normalization stats (must contain q01/q99; generated below)
+│   └── modality.json      # state/action/video key mapping (GR00T-specific)
+├── data/chunk-000/        # parquet files (state, action per timestep)
+└── videos/chunk-000/      # mp4 video files per episode
+```
+
+After downloading, run the following steps from the LoongForge root (replace `{suite}` with the dataset directory of each suite):
+
+```bash
+# 1. Overwrite modality.json (all four suites)
+cp examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/dataset/modality.json \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/{suite}/meta/modality.json
+
+# 2. Generate meta/stats.json (normalization stats with q01/q99) for all four suites;
+#    the script overwrites each dataset's meta/stats.json in place
+python examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/gen_stats.py \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot
+
+# 3. Goal suite only: replace one corrupted video
+cp examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/dataset/Goal/patches/episode_000082.mp4 \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/videos/chunk-000/observation.images.wrist_image/
+```
+
+---
+
+## 2. Finetuning
+
+### 2.1 Launch Training
+
+Training script: `examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/run_libero_sft.sh`
+
+Set the LoongForge, pretrained-weight and dataset paths in the script (or pass them as environment variables), then start training:
+
+> **Notes**:
+> - `data.embodiment_tag=libero_sim` tells GR00T-N1.7 that the data comes from the Panda arm in the LIBERO simulator. **Do not change it.**
+> - If a CUDA Graph replay fails, training automatically falls back to eager mode and continues normally.
+
+```bash
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO
+
+# Finetune a single suite, e.g. Spatial
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge \
+CHECKPOINT_PATH=/path/to/GR00T-N1.7-3B \
+COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \
+DATASET_ROOT=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY \
+OUTPUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs/gr00t_n1_7_libero \
+bash run_libero_sft.sh spatial
+
+# Finetune all suites in turn (spatial, object, goal, 10)
+bash run_libero_sft.sh all
+
+# Smoke test: run only 20 iterations to validate the training pipeline
+TRAIN_ITERS=20 SAVE_INTERVAL=20 bash run_libero_sft.sh goal
+```
+
+Each suite is trained separately. Checkpoints are saved to `$OUTPUT_ROOT/libero_<suite>/checkpoints/steps_<N>` and training logs to `$OUTPUT_ROOT/libero_<suite>.log`.
+
+### 2.2 Key Parameters
+
+**Script parameters** (all can be overridden via environment variables):
+
+| Parameter | Default | Description |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `LOONGFORGE_PATH` | - | LoongForge repository root |
+| `CHECKPOINT_PATH` | - | GR00T-N1.7-3B pretrained weight directory (must contain `config.json`) |
+| `COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH` | - | Cosmos-Reason2-2B directory; also the default value of `TOKENIZER_PATH` |
+| `DATASET_ROOT` | - | Root directory holding each suite's `libero_<suite>_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/` dataset |
+| `OUTPUT_ROOT` | - | Output root; each suite writes to its own `libero_<suite>/` subdirectory |
+| `GPUS_PER_NODE` / `NNODES` | 8 / 1 | GPUs per node / number of nodes |
+| `TRAIN_ITERS` | 20000 | Total training iterations |
+| `GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE` | 640 | Global batch size; must be divisible by number of GPUs × gradient accumulation steps |
+| `GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS` | 1 | Gradient accumulation steps; the per-device batch size is derived from the two values above |
+| `SAVE_INTERVAL` | 1000 | Checkpoint save interval (iterations) |
+| `LR_WARMUP_ITERS` | `TRAIN_ITERS / 20` | Learning-rate warmup iterations (5%), followed by cosine decay to 0; peak learning rate is 1e-4 |
+
+**Model and data configuration**: model and data parameters are configured in `configs/models/embodied/gr00t_n1_7.yaml`. Commonly used fields:
+
+| Field | Default | Description |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `data.embodiment_tag` | `new_embodiment` | Embodiment tag that selects the projector and modality layout; set to `libero_sim` in the LIBERO script |
+| `data.preprocess_action_horizon` | 16 | Action chunk length of each sample |
+| `data.state_dropout_prob` / `model.state_dropout_prob` | 0.2 | Probability of dropping the state input during training |
+| `data.use_relative_action` | true | Whether to use relative actions |
+| `data.use_percentiles` / `data.clip_outliers` | true / true | Normalize with q01/q99 from `stats.json` and clip outliers |
+| `model.tune_llm` / `model.tune_visual` | false / false | Whether to train the LLM / vision encoder |
+| `model.tune_projector` / `model.tune_diffusion_model` | true / true | Whether to train the projector / action head (DiT) |
+
+We recommend overriding these fields as command-line arguments in the script's `OVERRIDES` instead of editing the config file. For example:
+
+```bash
+OVERRIDES=(
+    data.embodiment_tag=libero_sim
+    model.state_dropout_prob=0.5
+    data.state_dropout_prob=0.5
+    data.preprocess_action_horizon=8
+)
+```
+
+### 2.3 Training Acceleration
+
+The LIBERO script enables full-iteration CUDA Graph by default: the first few iterations run eagerly as warmup, then one whole training step (forward, backward, DDP gradient sync and optimizer update) is captured into a single CUDA Graph and replayed on every subsequent step, eliminating host-side scheduling and kernel-launch overhead. The related arguments live in the script's `DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS`:
+
+| Argument | Script value | Description |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `--cuda-graph-impl` | `local` | CUDA Graph backend; `none` disables it |
+| `--cuda-graph-scope` | `full_iteration` | Capture scope; GR00T-N1.7 only supports `full_iteration`, i.e. capturing the whole step |
+| `--cuda-graph-warmup-steps` | 3 | Number of eager warmup iterations before capture |
+| `--cuda-graph-pad-length` | 0 | Fixed padding length for text tokens; 0 means no fixed length is enforced |
+| `--cuda-graph-ddp-sync-in-graph` | on | Captures the DDP gradient all-reduce inside the graph; required in full-iteration mode |
+| `--ddp-static-graph` | on | Declares the graph static across iterations to enable DDP static-graph optimizations; used together with CUDA Graph |
+| `--no-ddp-find-unused-parameters` | on | Skips unused-parameter detection to reduce per-step overhead |
+| `--ddp-bucket-cap-mb` | 100 | Bucket size (MiB) of the DDP gradient all-reduce |
+| `--no-check-for-nan-in-loss-and-grad` | on | Disables the per-step host-side NaN check on loss/gradients, avoiding device-to-host syncs that would interrupt graph replay |
+
+Data-loading arguments (`DATA_ARGS`):
+
+| Argument | Script value | Description |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `--num-workers` | 4 | DataLoader workers per device; adjustable via the `NUM_WORKERS` environment variable |
+| `--dataloader-prefetch-factor` | 8 | Batches prefetched per worker (framework default: 2) |
+| `--dataloader-multiprocessing-context` | `fork` | Start method of DataLoader worker processes |
+| `--distributed-sampler-mode` | `block` | Partitions samples across ranks in contiguous shards (instead of round-robin) |
+
+**Fused operators**: GR00T-N1.7 depends on a set of custom fused CUDA operators, `gr00t_n1_7_op` (sources under `ops/cuda_source/gr00t_n1_7_op`), which reduce kernel count and memory traffic:
+
+| Operator | Description |
+|---|---|
+| Qwen3-VL fused ops | Fused vision / text RoPE, RMSNorm and SiLU-multiply kernels used in the backbone forward pass |
+| Fused AdamW | Fused AdamW built on `MultiTensorApply`, numerically aligned with PyTorch AdamW; provides a capturable variant that can be captured by CUDA Graph. Only used with `--optimizer TEFusedAdamW`; the LIBERO script's default `AdamW` does not use it |
+| DDP reducer bucket control | Controls gradient bucket initialization of the DDP `c10d::Reducer`, used together with in-graph gradient sync |
+
+On startup, the training script checks whether `gr00t_n1_7_op` can be imported and, if not, builds and installs it from source automatically (only needed once; takes a few minutes). You can also install it manually beforehand:
+
+```bash
+cd ops/cuda_source/gr00t_n1_7_op
+pip install --no-build-isolation -e .
+```
+
+> **Notes**:
+> - Only the sm_80 and sm_120 architectures are compiled by default. For other GPUs, specify the architecture via `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST`, e.g. `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="9.0" pip install --no-build-isolation -e .`.
+> - Build parallelism is controlled by `NVCC_THREADS` (defaults to `MAX_JOBS`, then to 8).
+> - DDP reducer bucket control depends on PyTorch's internal ABI and must be built against the runtime PyTorch version; reinstall it after upgrading PyTorch.
+
+With CUDA Graph enabled, the end of the training log prints a `Full-iteration CUDA graph summary`, where `replays` is the number of replayed steps and `eager_fallbacks` the number of fallbacks to eager mode; use it to confirm that acceleration is in effect.
+

+| ![libero_spatial loss](../../assets/images/gr00t_n1_7/loss_libero_spatial.png) | ![libero_object loss](../../assets/images/gr00t_n1_7/loss_libero_object.png) |
+| **libero_goal** | **libero_10** |

+
+### 2.5 Correctness Verification
+
+To ensure training accuracy is not affected by the optimizations, we compared the step-by-step action loss of LoongForge's GR00T-N1.7 implementation against the official one, using identical data, weights and training configuration. The results show that LoongForge's performance optimizations (TEFusedAdamW, CUDA Graph, DDP static graph, etc.) preserve training accuracy:
+
+![GR00T-N1.7 precision](../../assets/images/precision/GR00TN1.7.png)
+
+---
+
+## 3. Evaluation Setup
+
+Install the base LIBERO environment following the official [LIBERO](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO) repository, then install the extra dependencies the eval client needs:
+
+```bash
+pip install websockets msgpack pyyaml
+```
+
+Alternatively, build the evaluation environment following [Isaac-GR00T](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T):
+
+```bash
+git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T.git
+cd Isaac-GR00T
+bash gr00t/eval/sim/LIBERO/setup_libero.sh
+pip install websockets
+```
+
+Evaluation uses a server / client architecture: the LoongForge policy server loads the checkpoint and runs inference, while the LIBERO simulator acts as the client. The two can use different Python environments, specified by `SERVER_PY` and `BENCHMARK_PYTHON` below.
+
+---
+
+## 4. Evaluation
+
+### 4.1 Launch
+
+`examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval/run_libero_eval.sh` evaluates the four suites serially, 200 episodes per suite (10 tasks × 20 episodes). The script starts and stops the policy server itself; no manual deployment is needed:
+
+```bash
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval
+
+COSMOS_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \
+CKPT_PATH=/path/to/outputs/gr00t_n1_7_libero/libero_{suite}/checkpoints/steps_20000 \
+STATS_PATH=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_{suite}_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/meta/stats.json \
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge \
+OUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs \
+SERVER_PY=/path/to/policy/bin/python \
+BENCHMARK_PYTHON=/path/to/libero/bin/python \
+GPU=0 \
+bash run_libero_eval.sh
+
+# Smoke test: evaluate only 1 task × 2 episodes of libero_10
+SUITES=libero_10 EPISODES=2 MAX_TASKS=1 bash run_libero_eval.sh
+```
+
+### 4.2 Key Parameters
+
+| Parameter | Default | Description |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `COSMOS_PATH` | - | Local Cosmos-Reason2-2B directory |
+| `CKPT_PATH` | - | Finetuned checkpoint path; `{suite}` is replaced in turn with `spatial` / `object` / `goal` / `10` |
+| `STATS_PATH` | - | Statistics file (`stats.json`) of the suite; also supports `{suite}` |
+| `LOONGFORGE_PATH` | - | LoongForge repository root |
+| `OUT_ROOT` | - | Root directory for evaluation outputs |
+| `SERVER_PY` | `/usr/bin/python` | Python interpreter of the LoongForge policy server |
+| `BENCHMARK_PYTHON` | - | Python interpreter of the LIBERO simulator (LIBERO must be installed) |
+| `GPU` | 0 | GPU index to use |
+| `SUITES` | all four suites | Space-separated suites to evaluate, e.g. `"libero_spatial libero_goal"` |
+| `EPISODES` | 20 | Episodes per task; 10 × 20 = 200 matches the official protocol |
+| `MAX_TASKS` | 0 | Tasks evaluated per suite; 0 means all 10 tasks |
+| `SEED` | 42 | Random seed |
+| `MUJOCO_GL` | `egl` | MuJoCo rendering backend; can be switched to `osmesa` depending on the environment |
+
+The evaluation protocol (at most 720 steps per episode, action chunk of 8, etc.) is fixed in `eval/configs/libero/libero_<suite>.yaml`; path parameters are injected by the script at runtime, so no YAML needs editing.
+
+### 4.3 Results
+
+Success rates on the four suites (10 tasks × 20 episodes = 200 episodes per suite):
+
+| Suite | Successful episodes | LoongForge | Official N1.7 |
+|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
+| libero_spatial | 196 / 200 | 98.0% | 97.65% |
+| libero_object | 197 / 200 | 98.5% | 98.45% |
+| libero_goal | 193 / 200 | 96.5% | 97.5% |
+| libero_10 (Long) | 191 / 200 | 95.5% | 94.35% |
+| **Average** | **777 / 800** | **97.13%** | **96.99%** |
+
+> **Notes**:
+> - The "Official N1.7" column is taken from Isaac-GR00T `examples/LIBERO/README.md`.
+> - Evaluation is stochastic, so results vary slightly from run to run.
+

+# 快速入门：GR00T-N1.7 模型训练
+
+本文档以 LIBERO 四个 suite 为例，介绍如何在 LoongForge 框架下微调 **GR00T-N1.7**，并对得到的 checkpoint 进行评测。
+
+- [1. 训练准备](#1-训练准备)
+- [2. 微调训练](#2-微调训练)
+- [3. 评测准备](#3-评测准备)
+- [4. 评测](#4-评测)
+
+---
+
+## 1. 训练准备
+
+### 1.1 环境
+
+参照 LoongForge 安装指南，拉取最新 GPU 镜像并启动容器：
+
+```bash
+docker pull loongforge/loongforge:latest
+mkdir -p workspace
+docker run --gpus all --ipc=host -it --rm \
+  -v "$(pwd)/workspace:/workspace/data" \
+  -w /workspace/LoongForge \
+  loongforge/loongforge:latest bash
+```
+
+镜像开箱即可训练 GR00T，无需额外安装依赖。
+
+### 1.2 预训练权重
+
+从 Hugging Face 下载以下权重：
+
+| 权重 | 用途 |
+|---|---|
+| [GR00T-N1.7-3B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B) | 微调实际使用的预训练权重 |
+| [Cosmos-Reason2-2B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B) | 仅提供 VLM backbone 结构及 tokenizer / processor |
+
+> **注意**：Cosmos-Reason2-2B 的权重在加载后会被 GR00T-N1.7-3B 的权重覆盖。
+
+### 1.3 训练数据
+
+脚本默认使用官方预处理好的 LeRobot v2.1 格式数据集。如需使用自定义数据训练，请参照 [NVIDIA Isaac-GR00T](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T) 完成离线数据预处理，将原始数据转换为 LeRobot v2.1 格式后再用于训练。
+
+LIBERO 包含四个 suite，数据集托管在 Hugging Face 的 IPEC-COMMUNITY 组织下：
+
+| Suite | 侧重点 | 数据集 |
+|---|---|---|
+| Spatial | 空间推理 | [libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| Object | 物体泛化 | [libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| Goal | 目标条件学习 | [libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| 10 (Long) | 长程多步任务 | [libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+
+每个数据集的目录结构如下：
+
+```text
+my_dataset/
+├── meta/
+│   ├── info.json          # 数据集元信息
+│   ├── episodes.jsonl     # episode 索引与长度
+│   ├── tasks.jsonl        # 语言任务描述
+│   ├── stats.json         # 归一化统计量（须包含 q01/q99，由下文脚本生成）
+│   └── modality.json      # state/action/video 字段映射（GR00T 专用）
+├── data/chunk-000/        # parquet 文件（每个时间步的 state、action）
+└── videos/chunk-000/      # 每个 episode 的 mp4 视频
+```
+
+下载完成后，在 LoongForge 根目录下执行以下步骤（将 `{suite}` 替换为各 suite 的数据集目录）：
+
+```bash
+# 1. 覆盖 modality.json（四个 suite 都需要）
+cp examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/dataset/modality.json \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/{suite}/meta/modality.json
+
+# 2. 为四个 suite 生成 meta/stats.json（含 q01/q99 的归一化统计量），
+#    脚本会原地覆盖各数据集的 meta/stats.json
+python examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/gen_stats.py \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot
+
+# 3. 仅 Goal suite：替换一个损坏的视频
+cp examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/dataset/Goal/patches/episode_000082.mp4 \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/videos/chunk-000/observation.images.wrist_image/
+```
+
+---
+
+## 2. 微调训练
+
+### 2.1 启动训练
+
+训练脚本：`examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/run_libero_sft.sh`
+
+在脚本中设置 LoongForge、预训练权重和数据集路径（也可以通过环境变量传入），然后启动训练：
+
+> **注意**：
+> - `data.embodiment_tag=libero_sim` 用于告诉 GR00T-N1.7 数据来自 LIBERO 仿真器中的 Panda 机械臂，**请勿修改**。
+> - 如果 CUDA Graph 重放失败，训练会自动回退到 eager 模式并正常进行。
+
+```bash
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO
+
+# 微调单个 suite，例如 Spatial
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge \
+CHECKPOINT_PATH=/path/to/GR00T-N1.7-3B \
+COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \
+DATASET_ROOT=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY \
+OUTPUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs/gr00t_n1_7_libero \
+bash run_libero_sft.sh spatial
+
+# 依次微调全部 suite（spatial、object、goal、10）
+bash run_libero_sft.sh all
+
+# 冒烟测试：只跑 20 步验证训练链路
+TRAIN_ITERS=20 SAVE_INTERVAL=20 bash run_libero_sft.sh goal
+```
+
+每个 suite 单独训练，checkpoint 保存在 `$OUTPUT_ROOT/libero_<suite>/checkpoints/steps_<N>`，训练日志保存在 `$OUTPUT_ROOT/libero_<suite>.log`。
+
+### 2.2 关键参数
+
+**脚本参数**（均可通过环境变量覆盖）：
+
+| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `LOONGFORGE_PATH` | - | LoongForge 仓库根目录 |
+| `CHECKPOINT_PATH` | - | GR00T-N1.7-3B 预训练权重目录（须包含 `config.json`） |
+| `COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH` | - | Cosmos-Reason2-2B 目录，同时作为 `TOKENIZER_PATH` 的默认值 |
+| `DATASET_ROOT` | - | 存放各 suite 数据集 `libero_<suite>_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/` 的根目录 |
+| `OUTPUT_ROOT` | - | 输出根目录，每个 suite 输出到 `libero_<suite>/` 子目录 |
+| `GPUS_PER_NODE` / `NNODES` | 8 / 1 | 每节点 GPU 数 / 节点数 |
+| `TRAIN_ITERS` | 20000 | 总训练步数 |
+| `GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE` | 640 | 全局 batch size，须能被 GPU 数 × 梯度累积步数整除 |
+| `GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS` | 1 | 梯度累积步数，每卡 batch size 由前两项自动计算 |
+| `SAVE_INTERVAL` | 1000 | checkpoint 保存间隔（步） |
+| `LR_WARMUP_ITERS` | `TRAIN_ITERS / 20` | 学习率 warmup 步数（5%），之后按 cosine 衰减到 0，峰值学习率 1e-4 |
+
+**模型与数据配置**：模型和数据相关参数在 `configs/models/embodied/gr00t_n1_7.yaml` 中配置，常用字段如下：
+
+| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `data.embodiment_tag` | `new_embodiment` | 本体标签，决定使用的 projector 和 modality 布局；LIBERO 脚本中设置为 `libero_sim` |
+| `data.preprocess_action_horizon` | 16 | 每个样本的 action chunk 长度 |
+| `data.state_dropout_prob` / `model.state_dropout_prob` | 0.2 | 训练时丢弃 state 输入的概率 |
+| `data.use_relative_action` | true | 是否使用相对动作 |
+| `data.use_percentiles` / `data.clip_outliers` | true / true | 使用 `stats.json` 中的 q01/q99 进行归一化并截断离群值 |
+| `model.tune_llm` / `model.tune_visual` | false / false | 是否训练 LLM / 视觉编码器 |
+| `model.tune_projector` / `model.tune_diffusion_model` | true / true | 是否训练 projector / action head（DiT） |
+
+推荐在脚本的 `OVERRIDES` 中以命令行参数覆盖这些字段，无需修改配置文件。例如：
+
+```bash
+OVERRIDES=(
+    data.embodiment_tag=libero_sim
+    model.state_dropout_prob=0.5
+    data.state_dropout_prob=0.5
+    data.preprocess_action_horizon=8
+)
+```
+
+### 2.3 训练加速
+
+LIBERO 脚本默认开启 full-iteration CUDA Graph：前几步以 eager 模式 warmup，之后把一整步训练（forward、backward、DDP 梯度同步、优化器更新）捕获为一张 CUDA Graph，后续每步直接重放，消除 host 侧调度和 kernel launch 开销。相关参数位于脚本的 `DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS` 中：
+
+| 参数 | 脚本取值 | 说明 |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `--cuda-graph-impl` | `local` | CUDA Graph 后端，`none` 表示关闭 |
+| `--cuda-graph-scope` | `full_iteration` | 捕获范围；GR00T-N1.7 仅支持 `full_iteration`，即整步捕获 |
+| `--cuda-graph-warmup-steps` | 3 | 捕获前以 eager 模式运行的 warmup 步数 |
+| `--cuda-graph-pad-length` | 0 | 文本 token 的固定 padding 长度，0 表示不强制固定长度 |
+| `--cuda-graph-ddp-sync-in-graph` | 开启 | 将 DDP 梯度 all-reduce 一并捕获进 graph，full-iteration 模式下必须开启 |
+| `--ddp-static-graph` | 开启 | 声明各步计算图不变，启用 DDP 静态图优化，配合 CUDA Graph 使用 |
+| `--no-ddp-find-unused-parameters` | 开启 | 跳过未使用参数的检测，减少每步开销 |
+| `--ddp-bucket-cap-mb` | 100 | DDP 梯度 all-reduce 的 bucket 大小（MiB） |
+| `--no-check-for-nan-in-loss-and-grad` | 开启 | 关闭每步 host 侧 loss/梯度 NaN 检查，避免 device→host 同步打断 graph 重放 |
+
+数据加载侧的相关参数（`DATA_ARGS`）：
+
+| 参数 | 脚本取值 | 说明 |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `--num-workers` | 4 | 每卡 DataLoader worker 数，可通过 `NUM_WORKERS` 环境变量调整 |
+| `--dataloader-prefetch-factor` | 8 | 每个 worker 预取的 batch 数（框架默认 2） |
+| `--dataloader-multiprocessing-context` | `fork` | DataLoader worker 的进程启动方式 |
+| `--distributed-sampler-mode` | `block` | 按连续分片（而非轮转）为各 rank 划分样本 |
+
+**融合算子**：GR00T-N1.7 依赖一组自定义 CUDA 融合算子 `gr00t_n1_7_op`（源码位于 `ops/cuda_source/gr00t_n1_7_op`），用于减少 kernel 数量和显存读写：
+
+| 算子 | 说明 |
+|---|---|
+| Qwen3-VL 融合算子 | 视觉 / 文本 RoPE、RMSNorm、SiLU-multiply 融合 kernel，用于 backbone 前向 |
+| Fused AdamW | 基于 `MultiTensorApply` 的融合 AdamW，与 PyTorch AdamW 数值对齐；提供 capturable 版本，可被 CUDA Graph 捕获。仅在 `--optimizer TEFusedAdamW` 时使用，LIBERO 脚本默认的 `AdamW` 不会用到 |
+| DDP reducer bucket control | 控制 DDP `c10d::Reducer` 的梯度 bucket 初始化，配合 graph 内梯度同步使用 |
+
+训练脚本启动时会检查 `gr00t_n1_7_op` 是否可导入，未安装时自动从源码编译安装（仅首次需要，耗时数分钟）。也可以提前手动安装：
+
+```bash
+cd ops/cuda_source/gr00t_n1_7_op
+pip install --no-build-isolation -e .
+```
+
+> **注意**：
+> - 默认只编译 sm_80 和 sm_120 架构。其他 GPU 需通过 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` 指定，例如 `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="9.0" pip install --no-build-isolation -e .`。
+> - 编译并行度由 `NVCC_THREADS`（默认取 `MAX_JOBS`，再默认 8）控制。
+> - DDP reducer bucket control 依赖 PyTorch 内部 ABI，须与运行时的 PyTorch 版本一同编译；升级 PyTorch 后需重新安装。
+
+开启 CUDA Graph 后，训练日志末尾会打印 `Full-iteration CUDA graph summary`，其中 `replays` 为重放步数、`eager_fallbacks` 为回退到 eager 的次数，可用于确认加速是否生效。
+

+
+为保证训练精度不受优化手段影响，我们在相同数据、权重和训练配置下，对 LoongForge 适配的 GR00T-N1.7 与官方实现进行了逐 step 的 action loss 对比验证。结果表明，LoongForge 的各项性能优化（如 TEFusedAdamW、CUDA Graph、DDP static graph 等）对训练精度无损：
+
+![GR00T-N1.7 precision](../../assets/images/precision/GR00TN1.7.png)
+

+## 3. 评测准备
+
+参照官方 [LIBERO](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO) 仓库安装基础 LIBERO 环境，再安装评测 client 所需的额外依赖：

+### 4.1 启动评测

+`examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval/run_libero_eval.sh` 会依次评测四个 suite，每个 suite 200 个 episode（10 个任务 × 20 个 episode）。脚本会自动启动和关闭 policy server，无需手动部署：

+```bash
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval

+COSMOS_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \

+STATS_PATH=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_{suite}_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/meta/stats.json \

+OUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs \
+SERVER_PY=/path/to/policy/bin/python \
+BENCHMARK_PYTHON=/path/to/libero/bin/python \
+GPU=0 \
+bash run_libero_eval.sh

+### 4.2 关键参数

+| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
+|---|:---:|---|
+| `COSMOS_PATH` | - | 本地 Cosmos-Reason2-2B 目录 |
+| `CKPT_PATH` | - | 微调得到的 checkpoint 路径，`{suite}` 会依次替换为 `spatial` / `object` / `goal` / `10` |

-## 2. 启动训练
-
-先统一设置路径：
-
-```bash
-cd /workspace/LoongForge
-
-export LOONGFORGE_PATH=/workspace/LoongForge/
-export CHECKPOINT_PATH=/workspace/huggingface.co/GR00T-N1.7-3B

-export OUTPUT_DIR=/workspace/outputs/groot_n1_7
-export TENSORBOARD_PATH=/workspace/tensorboard-log/groot_n1_7
-```
-
-### 2.1 验证训练链路
-
-先用最小配置跑通数据加载、权重加载、DDP 通信和 forward/backward 链路。此模式关闭所有性能优化，使用标准 `AdamW`：
-
-```bash
-bash /workspace/LoongForge/examples/embodied/groot_n1_7/run_groot_n1_7_ddp_finetune.sh \
-    --optimizer AdamW \
-    --cuda-graph-impl none \
-    --cuda-graph-pad-length 0 \
-    --no-ddp-static-graph \
-    --train-iters 10
-```
-
-### 2.2 默认训练配置
-
-脚本默认同时开启以下优化项，可直接运行：
-
-```bash
-bash /workspace/LoongForge/examples/embodied/groot_n1_7/run_groot_n1_7_ddp_finetune.sh
-```
-
-默认启用的优化包括：
-
-- **TEFusedAdamW** — 融合优化器，减少优化器 step 的 kernel launch 开销；
-- **CUDA Graph** — `per_microbatch` 模式，对每个 microbatch 捕获 CUDA Graph 以减少 host 侧调度开销；
-- **DDP Static Graph** — 启用 DDP 静态图模式，配合 CUDA Graph 使用；
-
-如需关闭某项优化，可在命令末尾覆盖对应参数，例如回退到普通 AdamW：
-
-```bash
---optimizer AdamW
-```
-
-或关闭 CUDA Graph：
-
-```bash
---cuda-graph-impl none
-```
-
-CUDA Graph 补充说明：
-
-- `--cuda-graph-pad-length 0` 表示不强制固定 token 长度，实际 padding 使用数据配置中的 `max_token_len` 或动态 batch padding；
-- 如需固定文本长度以提高 graph 复用率，可设置非零 `--cuda-graph-pad-length`。
-
-### 2.3 正确性验证
-
-为保证训练精度不受优化手段影响，我们在相同数据、权重和训练配置下，对 LoongForge 适配的 GR00T-N1.7 与官方实现进行了逐 step 的 action loss 对比验证。结果表明，LoongForge 的各项性能优化（如 TEFusedAdamW、CUDA Graph、DDP static graph 等）对训练精度无损：

+# GR00T-N1.7 Finetuning and Evaluation on LIBERO
+
+This guide walks through finetuning GR00T-N1.7 on the four LIBERO suites with LoongForge and evaluating the resulting checkpoints.
+
+- [1. Training Setup](#1-training-setup)
+- [2. Finetuning](#2-finetuning)
+- [3. Evaluation Setup](#3-evaluation-setup)
+- [4. Evaluation](#4-evaluation)
+
+---
+
+## 1. Training Setup
+
+### 1.1 Environment
+
+Following the LoongForge installation guide, pull the latest GPU image and start a container:
+
+```bash
+docker pull loongforge/loongforge:latest
+mkdir -p workspace
+docker run --gpus all --ipc=host -it --rm \
+  -v "$(pwd)/workspace:/workspace/data" \
+  -w /workspace/LoongForge \
+  loongforge/loongforge:latest bash
+```
+
+The image can train GR00T out of the box; no extra dependencies are required.
+
+### 1.2 Pretrained Weights
+
+Download the following weights from Hugging Face:
+
+| Weights | Purpose |
+|---|---|
+| [GR00T-N1.7-3B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B) | The pretrained weights actually used for finetuning |
+| [Cosmos-Reason2-2B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B) | Only provides the VLM backbone architecture and the tokenizer / processor |
+
+> **Note**: the Cosmos-Reason2-2B weights are overwritten by the GR00T-N1.7-3B weights after loading.
+
+### 1.3 Training Data
+
+LIBERO has four suites. The datasets are hosted under the IPEC-COMMUNITY organization on Hugging Face:
+
+| Suite | Focus | Dataset |
+|---|---|---|
+| Spatial | Spatial reasoning | [libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| Object | Object generalization | [libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| Goal | Goal-conditioned learning | [libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+| 10 (Long) | Long-horizon multi-step tasks | [libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot) |
+
+Each dataset has the following layout:
+
+```text
+my_dataset/
+├── meta/
+│   ├── info.json          # dataset metadata
+│   ├── episodes.jsonl     # episode index and lengths
+│   ├── tasks.jsonl        # language task descriptions
+│   ├── stats.json         # normalization stats (must contain q01/q99; generated below)
+│   └── modality.json      # state/action/video key mapping (GR00T-specific)
+├── data/chunk-000/        # parquet files (state, action per timestep)
+└── videos/chunk-000/      # mp4 video files per episode
+```
+
+After downloading, run the following steps from the LoongForge root (replace `{suite}` with the dataset directory of each suite):
+
+```bash
+# 1. Overwrite modality.json (all four suites)
+cp examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/dataset/modality.json \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/{suite}/meta/modality.json
+
+# 2. Generate meta/stats.json (normalization stats with q01/q99) for all four suites;
+#    the script overwrites each dataset's meta/stats.json in place
+python examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/gen_stats.py \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_spatial_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_object_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_10_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot
+
+# 3. Goal suite only: replace one corrupted video
+cp examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/dataset/Goal/patches/episode_000082.mp4 \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_goal_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/videos/chunk-000/observation.images.wrist_image/
+```
+
+---
+
+## 2. Finetuning
+
+Training script: `examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO/run_libero_sft.sh`
+
+Set the LoongForge, pretrained-weight and dataset paths in the script (or pass them as environment variables), then start training.
+
+> **Notes**:
+> - `data.embodiment_tag=libero_sim` tells GR00T-N1.7 that the data comes from the Panda arm in the LIBERO simulator. **Do not change it.**
+> - If a CUDA Graph replay fails, training automatically falls back to eager mode and continues normally.
+
+```bash
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/LIBERO
+
+# Finetune a single suite, e.g. Spatial
+bash run_libero_sft.sh spatial
+
+# Finetune all suites (spatial, object, goal, 10)
+bash run_libero_sft.sh all
+```
+
+
+### 2.1 Training Time
+
+Training time on 8 × A800:
+
+| Suite | Wall-clock time |
+|---|:---:|
+| libero_spatial | 4h 33m 35s |
+| libero_object | 5h 30m 09s |
+| libero_goal | 4h 27m 19s |
+| libero_10 | 6h 12m 01s |
+| **Total** | **20h 43m 04s** |
+
+### 2.2 Loss Curves
+
+| libero_spatial | libero_object |
+|:---:|:---:|
+| ![libero_spatial loss](../../../../docs/assets/images/gr00t_n1_7/loss_libero_spatial.png) | ![libero_object loss](../../../../docs/assets/images/gr00t_n1_7/loss_libero_object.png) |
+| **libero_goal** | **libero_10** |
+| ![libero_goal loss](../../../../docs/assets/images/gr00t_n1_7/loss_libero_goal.png) | ![libero_10 loss](../../../../docs/assets/images/gr00t_n1_7/loss_libero_10.png) |
+
+---
+
+## 3. Evaluation Setup
+
+Install the base LIBERO environment following the official [LIBERO](https://github.com/Lifelong-Robot-Learning/LIBERO) repository, then install the extra dependencies the eval client needs:
+
+```bash
+pip install websockets msgpack pyyaml
+```
+
+Alternatively, build the evaluation environment following [Isaac-GR00T](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T):
+
+```bash
+git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T.git
+cd Isaac-GR00T
+bash gr00t/eval/sim/LIBERO/setup_libero.sh
+pip install websockets
+```
+
+---
+
+## 4. Evaluation
+
+### 4.1 Launch
+
+`examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval/run_libero_eval.sh` evaluates the four suites serially, 200 episodes per suite (10 tasks × 20 episodes):
+
+```bash
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval
+
+COSMOS_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \
+CKPT_PATH=/path/to/libero_{suite}/checkpoints \
+STATS_PATH=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/libero_{suite}_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/meta/stats.json \
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge \
+OUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs \
+SERVER_PY=/path/to/policy/bin/python \
+BENCHMARK_PYTHON=/path/to/libero/bin/python \
+GPU=0 \
+bash run_libero_eval.sh
+```
+
+Main parameters:
+
+| Parameter | Description |
+|---|---|
+| `COSMOS_PATH` | Local Cosmos-Reason2-2B directory |
+| `CKPT_PATH` | Finetuned checkpoint path; `{suite}` is replaced in turn with `spatial` / `object` / `goal` / `10` |
+| `STATS_PATH` | Statistics file (`stats.json`) of the suite; also supports `{suite}` |
+| `LOONGFORGE_PATH` | LoongForge repository root |
+| `OUT_ROOT` | Root directory for evaluation outputs |
+| `SERVER_PY` | Python interpreter of the LoongForge policy server |
+| `BENCHMARK_PYTHON` | Python interpreter of the LIBERO simulator (LIBERO must be installed) |
+| `GPU` | GPU index to use |
+
+### 4.2 Results
+
+Success rates on the four suites (10 tasks × 20 episodes = 200 episodes per suite):
+
+| Suite | Successful episodes | LoongForge | Official N1.7 |
+|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
+| libero_spatial | 196 / 200 | 98.0% | 97.65% |
+| libero_object | 197 / 200 | 98.5% | 98.45% |
+| libero_goal | 193 / 200 | 96.5% | 97.5% |
+| libero_10 (Long) | 191 / 200 | 95.5% | 94.35% |
+| **Average** | **777 / 800** | **97.13%** | **96.99%** |
+
+> **Notes**:
+> - The "Official N1.7" column is taken from Isaac-GR00T `examples/LIBERO/README.md`.
+> - Evaluation is stochastic, so results vary slightly from run to run.

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Copyright 2026 The LoongForge Authors.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+#
+# run_libero_sft.sh - GR00T N1.7 LIBERO SFT on LoongForge, DDP
+#
+# Each suite is finetuned separately -> one checkpoint per suite.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   bash run_libero_sft.sh spatial
+#   bash run_libero_sft.sh all                                    # spatial object goal 10
+#   TRAIN_ITERS=20 SAVE_INTERVAL=20 bash run_libero_sft.sh goal   # smoke test
+#   GPUS_PER_NODE=4 bash run_libero_sft.sh goal                   # 4x160
+#   bash run_libero_sft.sh spatial -- --log-interval 10           # extra train.py flags
+#   LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge CHECKPOINT_PATH=/path/to/GR00T-N1.7-3B \
+#   COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B DATASET_ROOT=/path/to/datasets \
+#   OUTPUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs bash run_libero_sft.sh spatial
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# ---- Paths ----
+export LOONGFORGE_PATH=${LOONGFORGE_PATH:-"/path/to/LoongForge"}
+CHECKPOINT_PATH=${CHECKPOINT_PATH:-"/path/to/gr00t/GR00T-N1.7-3B"}
+# Holds libero_<suite>_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot/ for each suite.
+DATASET_ROOT=${DATASET_ROOT:-"/path/to/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY"}
+OUTPUT_ROOT=${OUTPUT_ROOT:-"/path/to/outputs/gr00t_n1_7_libero"}
+# Qwen3-VL / Cosmos-Reason2 backbone (architecture + processor/tokenizer).
+export COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH=${COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH:-"/path/to/gr00t/Cosmos-Reason2-2B"}
+export TOKENIZER_PATH=${TOKENIZER_PATH:-"$COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH"}
+GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC=${GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC:-"$LOONGFORGE_PATH/ops/cuda_source/gr00t_n1_7_op"}
+TRAIN_PY=${TRAIN_PY:-"python"}
+
+# ---- Suites ----
+SUITES=()
+EXTRA_ARGS=()
+while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
+    if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; EXTRA_ARGS=("$@"); break; fi
+    SUITES+=("$1"); shift
+done
+if [ "${#SUITES[@]}" -eq 1 ] && [ "${SUITES[0]}" = "all" ]; then
+    SUITES=(spatial object goal 10)
+fi
+
+# GR00T-N1.7 fused CUDA ops (built once, then importable).
+if ! "$TRAIN_PY" -c "import gr00t_n1_7_op" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    [ -f "$GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC/setup.py" ] || {
+        echo "ERROR: gr00t_n1_7_op not installed and sources not found at $GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC." >&2
+        exit 1
+    }
+    echo "Installing GR00T-N1.7 CUDA operators from $GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC"
+    NVCC_THREADS=${NVCC_THREADS:-${MAX_JOBS:-8}} \
+        "$TRAIN_PY" -m pip install --no-build-isolation -e "$GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC"
+fi
+
+# ---- Env ----
+export PYTHONPATH="$LOONGFORGE_PATH:${PYTHONPATH:-}"
+export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=${TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE:-1}
+export NO_ALBUMENTATIONS_UPDATE=${NO_ALBUMENTATIONS_UPDATE:-1}
+export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=${TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM:-false}
+export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=${CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS:-8}
+
+# ---- Distributed ----
+GPUS_PER_NODE=${GPUS_PER_NODE:-8}
+NNODES=${NNODES:-${WORLD_SIZE:-1}}
+DISTRIBUTED_ARGS=(
+    --nproc_per_node "$GPUS_PER_NODE"
+    --nnodes "$NNODES"
+    --node_rank "${NODE_RANK:-${RANK:-0}}"
+    --master_addr "${MASTER_ADDR:-localhost}"
+    --master_port "${MASTER_PORT:-29500}"
+)
+
+# ---- Hyper-parameters (official recipe) ----
+TRAIN_ITERS=${TRAIN_ITERS:-20000}
+GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE=${GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE:-640}
+GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS=${GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS:-1}
+SAVE_INTERVAL=${SAVE_INTERVAL:-1000}
+SEED=${SEED:-42}
+NUM_WORKERS=${NUM_WORKERS:-4}
+# warmup_ratio 0.05 x max_steps, as iterations.
+LR_WARMUP_ITERS=${LR_WARMUP_ITERS:-$((TRAIN_ITERS / 20))}
+
+DENOM=$((GPUS_PER_NODE * NNODES * GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS))
+if [ $((GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE % DENOM)) -ne 0 ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE=$GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE not divisible by" \
+         "gpus($((GPUS_PER_NODE * NNODES))) x grad_accum($GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS)." >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=${PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE:-$((GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE / DENOM))}
+
+# ---- Preflight ----
+[ -f "$CHECKPOINT_PATH/config.json" ] || {
+    echo "ERROR: no base model at $CHECKPOINT_PATH (config.json missing)." >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+[ -f "$COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH/config.json" ] || {
+    echo "ERROR: no VL backbone at $COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH (config.json missing)." >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+for suite in "${SUITES[@]}"; do
+    d="$DATASET_ROOT/libero_${suite}_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot"
+    [ -f "$d/meta/modality.json" ] || {
+        echo "ERROR: $d/meta/modality.json missing (LIBERO modality patch not applied)." >&2
+        exit 1
+    }
+done
+
+# ---- Fixed args (shared by all suites) ----
+DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS=(
+    --distributed-strategy ddp
+    --dtype bfloat16
+    --ddp-bucket-cap-mb 100
+    --no-ddp-find-unused-parameters
+    --no-check-for-nan-in-loss-and-grad
+    --cuda-graph-impl local
+    --cuda-graph-scope full_iteration
+    --cuda-graph-warmup-steps 3
+    --cuda-graph-pad-length 0
+    --cuda-graph-ddp-sync-in-graph
+    --ddp-static-graph
+)
+
+# LIBERO embodiment: projector index 2 + libero_sim modality layout
+# (state [x, y, z, axis_angle(3), gripper_qpos(2)], 16-step action chunk),
+# the counterpart of the official --embodiment-tag LIBERO_PANDA.
+OVERRIDES=(
+    data.embodiment_tag=libero_sim
+)
+mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_ROOT"
+
+for suite in "${SUITES[@]}"; do
+    DATASET_PATH="$DATASET_ROOT/libero_${suite}_no_noops_1.0.0_lerobot"
+    OUTPUT_DIR="$OUTPUT_ROOT/libero_${suite}"
+    LOG_FILE="$OUTPUT_ROOT/libero_${suite}.log"
+    mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"
+
+    DATA_ARGS=(
+        --dataset-format lerobot_datasets
+        --dataset-strategy gr00t_n1_7
+        --dataset-path "$DATASET_PATH"
+        --lerobotdataset-version v2.1
+        --video-backend torchcodec
+        --num-workers "$NUM_WORKERS"
+        --dataloader-prefetch-factor 8
+        --dataloader-multiprocessing-context fork
+        --distributed-sampler-mode block
+    )
+
+    TRAINING_ARGS=(
+        --trainer-type GrootN1d7Trainer
+        --save-processor-config
+        --train-iters "$TRAIN_ITERS"
+        --per-device-batch-size "$PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE"
+        --gradient-accumulation-steps "$GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS"
+        --seed "$SEED"
+        --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
+        # HF cosine schedule decaying to 0, 5% warmup
+        --lr-base 1.0e-4
+        --lr-decay-style cosine_with_min_lr
+        --lr-warmup-iters "$LR_WARMUP_ITERS"
+        --min-lr 0.0
+        # HF Trainer AdamW defaults; weight decay on everything except bias/norm.
+        --optimizer AdamW
+        --clip-grad 1.0
+        --weight-decay 1.0e-5
+        --weight-decay-grouping bias_norm
+        --adam-beta1 0.9
+        --adam-beta2 0.999
+        --adam-eps 1e-8
+        # pt, not safetensors: under transformers 5.3.0 visual.patch_embed.proj.weight
+        # is non-contiguous and the safetensors writer rejects it.
+        --save-interval "$SAVE_INTERVAL"
+        --save-format "${SAVE_FORMAT:-pt}"
+        --pretrained-checkpoint "$CHECKPOINT_PATH"
+    )
+
+    LOGGING_ARGS=(
+        --log-interval "${LOG_INTERVAL:-1}"
+        --loss-log-rank -1
+        --wandb-mode "${WANDB_MODE:-disabled}"
+        --tensorboard-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR/tensorboard"
+    )
+
+    echo "=============================================================="
+    echo "  GR00T-N1.7 SFT - LIBERO ${suite}"
+    echo "  Base model: $CHECKPOINT_PATH"
+    echo "  Backbone:   $COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH"
+    echo "  Dataset:    $DATASET_PATH"
+    echo "  Output:     $OUTPUT_DIR"
+    echo "  GPUs=$((GPUS_PER_NODE * NNODES)) iters=$TRAIN_ITERS global_bs=$GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE" \
+         "(per-device $PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE x accum $GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS)"
+    echo "  warmup=$LR_WARMUP_ITERS save_interval=$SAVE_INTERVAL seed=$SEED"
+    echo "  Log:        $LOG_FILE"
+    echo "=============================================================="
+
+    "$TRAIN_PY" -m torch.distributed.run "${DISTRIBUTED_ARGS[@]}" \
+        "$LOONGFORGE_PATH/loongforge/embodied/train.py" \
+        --model-name gr00t_n1_7 \
+        "${DATA_ARGS[@]}" \
+        "${TRAINING_ARGS[@]}" \
+        "${DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS[@]}" \
+        "${LOGGING_ARGS[@]}" \
+        "${OVERRIDES[@]}" \
+        ${EXTRA_ARGS[@]+"${EXTRA_ARGS[@]}"} 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_FILE"
+done
+
+echo "All requested LIBERO suites finished. Checkpoints under $OUTPUT_ROOT/libero_<suite>/checkpoints/steps_<N>"

+# GR00T-N1.7 Finetuning and Evaluation on SimplerEnv
+
+This guide walks through finetuning GR00T-N1.7 with LoongForge on the two SimplerEnv embodiments — **Bridge / WidowX** and **Fractal / Google Robot** — and evaluating the resulting checkpoints.
+
+- [1. Training Setup](#1-training-setup)
+- [2. Finetuning](#2-finetuning)
+- [3. Evaluation Setup](#3-evaluation-setup)
+- [4. Evaluation](#4-evaluation)
+
+---
+
+## 1. Training Setup
+
+### 1.1 Environment
+
+Following the [LoongForge](https://github.com/baidu-baige/LoongForge) installation guide, pull the latest GPU image and start a container:
+
+```bash
+docker pull loongforge/loongforge:latest
+mkdir -p workspace
+docker run --gpus all --ipc=host -it --rm \
+  -v "$(pwd)/workspace:/workspace/data" \
+  -w /workspace/LoongForge \
+  loongforge/loongforge:latest bash
+```
+
+### 1.2 Pretrained Weights
+
+Download the following weights from Hugging Face:
+
+| Weights | Purpose |
+|---|---|
+| [GR00T-N1.7-3B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B) | The pretrained weights actually used for finetuning |
+| [Cosmos-Reason2-2B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Cosmos-Reason2-2B) | Only provides the VLM backbone architecture and the tokenizer / processor |
+
+> **Note**: the Cosmos-Reason2-2B weights are overwritten by the GR00T-N1.7-3B weights after loading.
+
+### 1.3 Training Data
+
+The training data for both embodiments is hosted under the IPEC-COMMUNITY organization on Hugging Face:
+
+| Embodiment | Robot | Dataset | State | Action | Camera |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| Bridge | WidowX | [bridge_orig_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/bridge_orig_lerobot) | 8D `x,y,z,roll,pitch,yaw,pad,gripper` | 7D absolute EEF (Euler angles) | `image_0` |
+| Fractal | Google Robot | [fractal20220817_data_lerobot](https://huggingface.co/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/fractal20220817_data_lerobot) | 8D `x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,rw,gripper` (quaternion) | 7D absolute EEF (Euler angles) | `image` (256×320) |
+
+Each dataset has the following layout:
+
+```text
+my_dataset/
+├── meta/
+│   ├── info.json          # dataset metadata
+│   ├── episodes.jsonl     # episode index and lengths
+│   ├── tasks.jsonl        # language task descriptions
+│   ├── stats.json         # normalization stats (must contain q01/q99; generated below)
+│   └── modality.json      # state/action/video key mapping (GR00T-specific)
+├── data/chunk-000/        # parquet files (state, action per timestep)
+└── videos/chunk-000/      # mp4 video files per episode
+```
+
+After downloading, run the following steps from the LoongForge root:
+
+```bash
+# 1. Overwrite modality.json (both datasets)
+cp examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/SimplerEnv/bridge/modality.json \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/bridge_orig_lerobot/meta/modality.json
+cp examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/SimplerEnv/fractal/modality.json \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/fractal20220817_data_lerobot/meta/modality.json
+
+# 2. Generate meta/stats.json (normalization stats with q01/q99) for both datasets;
+#    the script overwrites each dataset's meta/stats.json in place
+python examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/gen_stats.py \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/bridge_orig_lerobot \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/fractal20220817_data_lerobot
+
+# 3. Fractal only: the videos are AV1-encoded, which torchcodec cannot decode;
+#    convert them to H.264 in place
+python examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/SimplerEnv/fractal/convert_av1_to_h264.py \
+   /path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/fractal20220817_data_lerobot/videos --jobs 8
+```
+
+> **Note**: Fractal has 87,212 episodes, so the AV1 conversion takes a long time.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Finetuning
+
+```bash
+# Finetune Bridge (WidowX)
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/SimplerEnv/bridge
+
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge \
+CHECKPOINT_PATH=/path/to/GR00T-N1.7-3B \
+COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \
+DATASET_PATH=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/bridge_orig_lerobot \
+OUTPUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs/gr00t_n1_7_bridge \
+bash run_bridge_sft.sh
+
+# Finetune Fractal (Google Robot)
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/SimplerEnv/fractal
+
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge \
+CHECKPOINT_PATH=/path/to/GR00T-N1.7-3B \
+COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \
+DATASET_PATH=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/fractal20220817_data_lerobot \
+OUTPUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs/gr00t_n1_7_fractal \
+bash run_fractal_sft.sh
+```
+
+> **Note**: due to tight GPU memory, CUDA Graph is disabled by default in the current configuration. If you have enough GPU memory, you can enable it by adding the following arguments to `DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS` in the training script:
+>
+> ```bash
+> --cuda-graph-impl local

+## 3. Evaluation Setup
+
+Install SimplerEnv following the official [SimplerEnv repository](https://github.com/simpler-env/SimplerEnv) (including the `ManiSkill2_real2sim` submodule), then install the extra dependencies:
+
+```bash
+pip install websockets msgpack msgpack-numpy pyyaml
+```
+
+Alternatively, build the evaluation environment following [Isaac-GR00T](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T):
+
+```bash
+git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T.git
+cd Isaac-GR00T

+uv pip install --python gr00t/eval/sim/SimplerEnv/simpler_uv/.venv/bin/python \

+```
+

+
+## 4. Evaluation
+
+### 4.1 Launch
+
+The scripts under `examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval/` run a serial evaluation: for each task they start a policy server, run all episodes, stop the server and move on to the next task, then aggregate the success rates.
+
+```bash
+cd examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval
+
+# Bridge (WidowX): 7 tasks x 100 episodes
+COSMOS_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \
+CKPT_PATH=/path/to/bridge/checkpoints \
+STATS_PATH=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/bridge_orig_lerobot/meta/stats.json \
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge \
+SIMPLERENV_ROOT=/path/to/SimplerEnv \
+BENCHMARK_PYTHON=/path/to/simplerenv/bin/python \
+OUT_ROOT=/path/to/bridge_output \
+bash run_simplerenv_bridge_eval.sh
+
+# Fractal (Google Robot): 6 tasks x 100 episodes
+COSMOS_PATH=/path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B \
+CKPT_PATH=/path/to/fractal/checkpoints \
+STATS_PATH=/path/to/IPEC-COMMUNITY/fractal20220817_data_lerobot/meta/stats.json \
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=/path/to/LoongForge \
+SIMPLERENV_ROOT=/path/to/SimplerEnv \
+BENCHMARK_PYTHON=/path/to/simplerenv/bin/python \
+OUT_ROOT=/path/to/fractal_output \
+bash run_simplerenv_fractal_eval.sh
+```
+
+Main parameters:
+

+|---|---|
+| `COSMOS_PATH` | Local Cosmos-Reason2-2B directory |
+| `CKPT_PATH` | Finetuned weights: a `pytorch_model.pt` file, or a directory with `config.json` + safetensors (e.g. the official checkpoint) |

+| `OUT_ROOT` | Root directory for evaluation outputs |
+| `SERVER_PY` | Python interpreter of the LoongForge policy server |
+| `BENCHMARK_PYTHON` | Python interpreter of the SimplerEnv simulator |

+#!/usr/bin/env bash

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+#
+# run_bridge_sft.sh - GR00T N1.7 SimplerEnv Bridge (WidowX) SFT on LoongForge, DDP
+#
+# Usage:
+#   bash run_bridge_sft.sh
+#   TRAIN_ITERS=20 SAVE_INTERVAL=20 bash run_bridge_sft.sh          # smoke test
+#   GPUS_PER_NODE=4 bash run_bridge_sft.sh                          # 4x256
+#   bash run_bridge_sft.sh -- --log-interval 10                     # extra train.py flags

+#   OUTPUT_ROOT=/path/to/outputs bash run_bridge_sft.sh
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# ---- Paths ----

+CHECKPOINT_PATH=${CHECKPOINT_PATH:-"/path/to/gr00t/GR00T-N1.7-3B"}
+DATASET_PATH=${DATASET_PATH:-"/path/to/datasets/IPEC-COMMUNITY/bridge_orig_lerobot"}

+export COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH=${COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH:-"/path/to/gr00t/Cosmos-Reason2-2B"}
+export TOKENIZER_PATH=${TOKENIZER_PATH:-"$COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH"}
+GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC=${GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC:-"$LOONGFORGE_PATH/ops/cuda_source/gr00t_n1_7_op"}
+TRAIN_PY=${TRAIN_PY:-"python"}
+
+# ---- Extra train.py flags (after --) ----
+EXTRA_ARGS=()
+while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
+    if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; EXTRA_ARGS=("$@"); break; fi
+    echo "WARN: ignoring positional arg '$1' (use '-- <flags>' to pass train.py flags)." >&2
+    shift
+done
+
+# GR00T-N1.7 fused CUDA ops (built once, then importable).
+if ! "$TRAIN_PY" -c "import gr00t_n1_7_op" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    [ -f "$GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC/setup.py" ] || {
+        echo "ERROR: gr00t_n1_7_op not installed and sources not found at $GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC." >&2
+        exit 1
+    }
+    echo "Installing GR00T-N1.7 CUDA operators from $GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC"
+    NVCC_THREADS=${NVCC_THREADS:-${MAX_JOBS:-8}} \
+        "$TRAIN_PY" -m pip install --no-build-isolation -e "$GR00T_N1_7_OPS_SRC"

+
+# ---- Env ----

+export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=${TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE:-1}
+export NO_ALBUMENTATIONS_UPDATE=${NO_ALBUMENTATIONS_UPDATE:-1}
+export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=${TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM:-false}
+export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=${CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS:-8}
+
+# ---- Distributed ----
+GPUS_PER_NODE=${GPUS_PER_NODE:-8}
+NNODES=${NNODES:-${WORLD_SIZE:-1}}
+DISTRIBUTED_ARGS=(

+    --nnodes "$NNODES"
+    --node_rank "${NODE_RANK:-${RANK:-0}}"

+    --master_port "${MASTER_PORT:-29500}"

+
+# ---- Hyper-parameters (official Bridge recipe) ----

+GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE=${GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE:-1024}
+GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS=${GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS:-1}
+SAVE_INTERVAL=${SAVE_INTERVAL:-1000}
+# Official --state-dropout-prob 0.8 is applied model-side (model.state_dropout_prob).
+STATE_DROPOUT_PROB=${STATE_DROPOUT_PROB:-0.8}
+SEED=${SEED:-42}
+NUM_WORKERS=${NUM_WORKERS:-4}

+
+DENOM=$((GPUS_PER_NODE * NNODES * GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS))
+if [ $((GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE % DENOM)) -ne 0 ]; then
+    echo "ERROR: GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE=$GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE not divisible by" \
+         "gpus($((GPUS_PER_NODE * NNODES))) x grad_accum($GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS)." >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=${PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE:-$((GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE / DENOM))}
+
+OUTPUT_DIR="$OUTPUT_ROOT/bridge_orig"
+LOG_FILE="$OUTPUT_ROOT/bridge_orig.log"

+
+MODEL_CONFIG_ARGS=(
+    --model-name gr00t_n1_7
+)
+
+DATA_ARGS=(
+    --dataset-format lerobot_datasets
+    --dataset-strategy gr00t_n1_7
+    --dataset-path "$DATASET_PATH"
+    --lerobotdataset-version v2.1
+    --video-backend torchcodec
+    --num-workers "$NUM_WORKERS"
+    --dataloader-prefetch-factor 8
+    --dataloader-multiprocessing-context fork
+    --distributed-sampler-mode block
+)
+
+TRAINING_ARGS=(
+    --trainer-type GrootN1d7Trainer
+    --save-processor-config
+    --train-iters "$TRAIN_ITERS"
+    --per-device-batch-size "$PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE"
+    --gradient-accumulation-steps "$GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS"
+    --seed "$SEED"
+    --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
+    # HF cosine schedule decaying to 0, 5% warmup
+    --lr-base 1.0e-4
+    --lr-decay-style cosine_with_min_lr
+    --lr-warmup-iters "$LR_WARMUP_ITERS"
+    --min-lr 0.0
+    # HF Trainer adamw_torch_fused defaults; weight decay on everything except bias/norm.
+    --optimizer TEFusedAdamW
+    --clip-grad 1.0
+    --weight-decay 1.0e-5
+    --weight-decay-grouping bias_norm
+    --adam-beta1 0.9
+    --adam-beta2 0.999
+    --adam-eps 1e-8
+    # pt, not safetensors: under transformers 5.3.0 visual.patch_embed.proj.weight
+    # is non-contiguous and the safetensors writer rejects it.
+    --save-interval "$SAVE_INTERVAL"
+    --save-format "${SAVE_FORMAT:-pt}"
+    --pretrained-checkpoint "$CHECKPOINT_PATH"
+)
+
+DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS=(
+    --distributed-strategy ddp
+    --dtype bfloat16
+    --ddp-bucket-cap-mb 100
+    --no-ddp-find-unused-parameters
+)
+
+LOGGING_ARGS=(
+    --log-interval "${LOG_INTERVAL:-1}"
+    --loss-log-rank -1
+    --wandb-mode "${WANDB_MODE:-disabled}"
+    --tensorboard-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR/tensorboard"
+)
+
+# WidowX embodiment, the counterpart of the official --embodiment-tag SIMPLER_ENV_WIDOWX.
+# simpler_env_widowx uses an 8-step action chunk, so override the yaml's 16.
+OVERRIDES=(
+    data.embodiment_tag=simpler_env_widowx
+    model.state_dropout_prob=$STATE_DROPOUT_PROB
+    data.preprocess_action_horizon=8
+)
+
+echo "=============================================================="
+echo "  GR00T-N1.7 SFT - SimplerEnv Bridge (WidowX)"
+echo "  Base model: $CHECKPOINT_PATH"
+echo "  Backbone:   $COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH"
+echo "  Dataset:    $DATASET_PATH"
+echo "  Output:     $OUTPUT_DIR"
+echo "  GPUs=$((GPUS_PER_NODE * NNODES)) iters=$TRAIN_ITERS global_bs=$GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE" \
+     "(per-device $PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE x accum $GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS)"
+echo "  warmup=$LR_WARMUP_ITERS save_interval=$SAVE_INTERVAL seed=$SEED" \
+     "state_dropout=$STATE_DROPOUT_PROB"
+echo "  Log:        $LOG_FILE"
+echo "=============================================================="
+
+"$TRAIN_PY" -m torch.distributed.run "${DISTRIBUTED_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "$LOONGFORGE_PATH/loongforge/embodied/train.py" \
+    "${MODEL_CONFIG_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${DATA_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${TRAINING_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${LOGGING_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${OVERRIDES[@]}" \
+    ${EXTRA_ARGS[@]+"${EXTRA_ARGS[@]}"} 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_FILE"
+
+echo "Bridge SFT finished. Checkpoints under $OUTPUT_DIR/checkpoints/steps_<N>"

+import argparse
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+
+VIDEO_EXTS = {".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv"}
+
+
+def run(cmd):
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
+
+
+def is_av1(path: Path) -> bool:
+    cmd = [
+        "ffprobe",
+        "-v",
+        "error",
+        "-select_streams",
+        "v:0",
+        "-show_entries",
+        "stream=codec_name",
+        "-of",
+        "default=nw=1:nk=1",
+        str(path),
+    ]
+    proc = run(cmd)
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        print(f"[ffprobe FAIL] {path}: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
+        return False
+    codec = proc.stdout.strip()
+    return codec in ("av01", "av1")
+
+
+def convert_file(path: Path):
+    if not is_av1(path):
+        print(f"[SKIP] {path}")
+        return
+
+    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".mp4")
+    print(f"[CONVERT] {path} -> {tmp}")
+
+    cmd = [
+        "ffmpeg",
+        "-y",
+        "-i",
+        str(path),
+        "-c:v",
+        "libx264",
+        "-qp",
+        "0",
+        "-pix_fmt",
+        "yuv420p",
+        "-c:a",
+        "copy",
+        "-vsync",
+        "passthrough",
+        "-copyts",
+        "-muxdelay",
+        "0",
+        "-muxpreload",
+        "0",
+        str(tmp),
+    ]
+    proc = run(cmd)
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        print(f"[ffmpeg FAIL] {path}: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
+        if tmp.exists():
+            tmp.unlink()
+        return
+
+    tmp.replace(path)
+    print(f"[DONE] {path}")
+
+
+def find_videos(root: Path):
+    for dirpath, _, filenames in os.walk(root):
+        for name in filenames:
+            p = Path(dirpath) / name
+            if p.suffix.lower() in VIDEO_EXTS:
+                yield p
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Recursively convert AV1 videos to H.264 (lossless-ish) in place."
+    )
+    ap.add_argument("root", nargs="?", default=".", help="Root directory (default: .)")
+    ap.add_argument(
+        "-j",
+        "--jobs",
+        type=int,
+        default=os.cpu_count() or 4,
+        help="Number of parallel workers (default: CPU count)",
+    )
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    files = list(find_videos(root))
+    print(f"Scanning {root}, found {len(files)} candidate video files")
+
+    if not files:
+        return
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.jobs) as ex:
+        for p in files:
+            ex.submit(convert_file, p)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+    echo "ERROR: GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE=$GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE not divisible by" \
+         "gpus($((GPUS_PER_NODE * NNODES))) x grad_accum($GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS)." >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=${PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE:-$((GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE / DENOM))}
+
+OUTPUT_DIR="$OUTPUT_ROOT/fractal"
+LOG_FILE="$OUTPUT_ROOT/fractal.log"
+mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"
+
+MODEL_CONFIG_ARGS=(
+    --model-name gr00t_n1_7
+)
+
+DATA_ARGS=(
+    --dataset-format lerobot_datasets
+    --dataset-strategy gr00t_n1_7
+    --dataset-path "$DATASET_PATH"
+    --lerobotdataset-version v2.1
+    --video-backend torchcodec
+    --num-workers "$NUM_WORKERS"
+    --dataloader-prefetch-factor 8
+    --dataloader-multiprocessing-context fork
+    --distributed-sampler-mode block
+)
+
+TRAINING_ARGS=(
+    --trainer-type GrootN1d7Trainer
+    --save-processor-config
+    --train-iters "$TRAIN_ITERS"
+    --per-device-batch-size "$PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE"
+    --gradient-accumulation-steps "$GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS"
+    --seed "$SEED"
+    --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR"
+    # HF cosine schedule decaying to 0, 5% warmup
+    --lr-base 1.0e-4
+    --lr-decay-style cosine_with_min_lr
+    --lr-warmup-iters "$LR_WARMUP_ITERS"
+    --min-lr 0.0
+    # HF Trainer adamw_torch_fused defaults; weight decay on everything except bias/norm.
+    --optimizer TEFusedAdamW
+    --clip-grad 1.0
+    --weight-decay 1.0e-5
+    --weight-decay-grouping bias_norm
+    --adam-beta1 0.9
+    --adam-beta2 0.999
+    --adam-eps 1e-8
+    # pt, not safetensors: under transformers 5.3.0 visual.patch_embed.proj.weight
+    # is non-contiguous and the safetensors writer rejects it.
+    --save-interval "$SAVE_INTERVAL"
+    --save-format "${SAVE_FORMAT:-pt}"
+    --pretrained-checkpoint "$CHECKPOINT_PATH"
+)
+
+DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS=(
+    --distributed-strategy ddp
+    --dtype bfloat16
+    --ddp-bucket-cap-mb 100
+    --no-ddp-find-unused-parameters
+)
+
+LOGGING_ARGS=(
+    --log-interval "${LOG_INTERVAL:-1}"
+    --loss-log-rank -1
+    --wandb-mode "${WANDB_MODE:-disabled}"
+    --tensorboard-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR/tensorboard"
+)
+
+# Google robot embodiment, the counterpart of the official --embodiment-tag SIMPLER_ENV_GOOGLE.
+# No built-in modality config for it: the layout comes from the dataset meta/modality.json.
+# 8-step action chunk, so override the yaml's 16.
+OVERRIDES=(
+    data.embodiment_tag=simpler_env_google
+    model.state_dropout_prob=$STATE_DROPOUT_PROB
+    data.state_dropout_prob=$STATE_DROPOUT_PROB
+    data.preprocess_action_horizon=8
+)
+
+echo "=============================================================="
+echo "  GR00T-N1.7 SFT - SimplerEnv Fractal (Google Robot)"
+echo "  Base model: $CHECKPOINT_PATH"
+echo "  Backbone:   $COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH"
+echo "  Dataset:    $DATASET_PATH"
+echo "  Output:     $OUTPUT_DIR"
+echo "  GPUs=$((GPUS_PER_NODE * NNODES)) iters=$TRAIN_ITERS global_bs=$GLOBAL_BATCH_SIZE" \
+     "(per-device $PER_DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE x accum $GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION_STEPS)"
+echo "  warmup=$LR_WARMUP_ITERS save_interval=$SAVE_INTERVAL seed=$SEED" \
+     "state_dropout=$STATE_DROPOUT_PROB"
+echo "  Log:        $LOG_FILE"
+echo "=============================================================="
+
+"$TRAIN_PY" -m torch.distributed.run "${DISTRIBUTED_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "$LOONGFORGE_PATH/loongforge/embodied/train.py" \
+    "${MODEL_CONFIG_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${DATA_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${TRAINING_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${DISTRIBUTED_TRAINING_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${LOGGING_ARGS[@]}" \
+    "${OVERRIDES[@]}" \
+    ${EXTRA_ARGS[@]+"${EXTRA_ARGS[@]}"} 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_FILE"
+
+echo "Fractal SFT finished. Checkpoints under $OUTPUT_DIR/checkpoints/steps_<N>"

+# Public template: replace every /path/to/... placeholder before use.
+#
+# GR00T-N1.7 x SimplerEnv Google robot (Fractal) -- google_robot_close_drawer, official parity.
+#   --max_episode_steps 300 -> benchmark.max_steps (counts INNER env steps)
+#   --n_action_steps 1      -> server.chunk_execute_steps (replan every step)
+#   simpler_env.make() forces prepackaged_config=True, so the env applies its
+#   own visual-matching scene / overlay / control_mode; no control_mode here.
+#
+
+benchmark:
+  name: simplerenv
+  task_name: google_robot_close_drawer
+  robot_setup: google_robot
+  prepackaged_config: true
+  sim_freq: 500
+  control_freq: 5
+  action_scale: 1.0
+  rotation_mode: axis_angle    # pass roll/pitch/yaw through unchanged
+  google_sticky_gripper: true  # official GoogleFractalEnv gripper (15-step sticky)
+  max_steps: 300
+  success_settle_steps: 0
+
+model:
+  backend: loongforge
+  model_type: Gr00tN1d7
+  base_model_path: /path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B
+  model_name: /path/to/Cosmos-Reason2-2B
+  # Raw-quaternion 8D state [pos(3), quat_xyzw(4), gripper_closedness] read
+  # from the Google agent's eef_pos; image resized to 320x256 like the official
+  # GoogleFractalEnv wrapper.
+  state_encoding: simpler_google
+  action_encoding: simpler_abs_euler
+  use_flash_attention: true
+  # Inference-only: keep the frozen backbone in bf16 and every head frozen,
+  # matching the server config the reported Fractal numbers were measured with.
+  backbone_trainable_params_fp32: false
+  tune_projector: false
+  tune_diffusion_model: false
+  tune_vlln: false
+
+server:
+  host: 127.0.0.1
+  port: 13839
+  health_port: 13840
+  python: /path/to/conda/envs/loongforge/bin/python
+  log: /path/to/reports/gr00t_n1_7/simplerenv/google_robot_close_drawer/policy_server.log
+  start_timeout_sec: 2400
+  random_init: false
+  ckpt_path: /path/to/GR00T-N1.7-SimplerEnv-Fractal
+  dataset_statistics_path: /path/to/GR00T-N1.7-SimplerEnv-Fractal/statistics.json
+  embodiment_tag: simpler_env_google
+  chunk_execute_steps: 1       # official --n_action_steps
+  use_bf16: true
+  loongforge_root: /path/to/LoongForge-VLA
+
+env:
+  eval_root: /path/to/LoongForge-VLA/loongforge/embodied/eval
+  # SimplerEnv checkout: the fork NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T pins as its
+  # `external_dependencies/SimplerEnv` submodule (exposes `agent.eef_pos`).
+  simplerenv_root: /path/to/SimplerEnv
+  ld_library_path: /path/to/nvidia_lib
+  nvidia_lib_dir: /path/to/nvidia_lib
+  nvidia_icd_json: /path/to/nvidia_lib/10_nvidia.json
+
+run:
+  output_dir: /path/to/reports/gr00t_n1_7/simplerenv/google_robot_close_drawer
+  seed: 0
+  episode_idx: 0
+  obj_episode_id: 0
+  save_trace: false
+  save_replay: false
+  # chunk_execute_steps=1 replans every step, so no server-side chunk is reused.
+  disable_action_cache: true
+  timestamped_output: false
+
+# The SimplerEnv runner evaluates ONE episode per invocation. Under
+# prepackaged_config the env randomizes the layout from its own episode_rng,
+# seeded by `run.seed + run.episode_idx`, so `run.episode_idx` above is the
+# episode variable (not run.obj_episode_id).
+
+timeouts:
+  policy_call_ms: 600000
+  per_step_sec: 600
+  per_episode_sec: 3600

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Copyright 2026 The LoongForge Authors.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+#
+# Public: GR00T-N1.7 LIBERO task-success, serial evaluation of one or more suites.
+#
+# - Each suite YAML (configs/libero/libero_<suite>.yaml) holds only the fixed eval
+#   protocol (benchmark.libero_protocol: gr00t_official, 720 steps, chunk 8, ...);
+#   the machine/artifact paths below are injected at runtime, so no YAML needs editing.
+# - One policy server per suite on a single GPU, one LIBERO env; suites, tasks and
+#   episodes all run serially. The orchestrator starts and stops the server itself.
+# - gr00t_official writes every invocation to a fresh
+#   <run>/<suite>/gr00t_official/<run-id>/ (resume/restart are ignored).
+#
+# Usage:
+#   bash run_libero_eval.sh                                         # 4 suites x 10 tasks x 20 episodes
+#   SUITES=libero_10 EPISODES=2 MAX_TASKS=1 bash run_libero_eval.sh # smoke test
+#   CKPT_PATH=/path/to/ckpt STATS_PATH=/path/to/stats.json SUITES=libero_10 bash run_libero_eval.sh
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# ---- Paths injected into the suite YAMLs at runtime ----
+COSMOS_PATH=${COSMOS_PATH:-"/path/to/gr00t/Cosmos-Reason2-2B"}
+# CKPT_PATH / STATS_PATH may contain {suite} (e.g. .../libero_{suite}/checkpoints/steps_20000);
+# it is replaced by the suite name without the libero_ prefix (10, goal, object, spatial).
+CKPT_PATH=${CKPT_PATH:-"/path/to/GR00T-N1.7-LIBERO/libero_{suite}"}
+STATS_PATH=${STATS_PATH:-"/path/to/GR00T-N1.7-LIBERO/libero_{suite}/statistics.json"}
+LOONGFORGE_PATH=${LOONGFORGE_PATH:-"/path/to/LoongForge"}
+OUT_ROOT=${OUT_ROOT:-"/path/to/reports"}
+SERVER_PY=${SERVER_PY:-"/usr/bin/python"}
+
+# ---- Other run parameters ----
+CONFIG_DIR=${CONFIG_DIR:-"$LOONGFORGE_PATH/examples/embodied/gr00t_n1_7/eval/configs/libero"}
+BENCHMARK_PYTHON=${BENCHMARK_PYTHON:-"/path/to/bin/python"}
+RUN_TAG=${RUN_TAG:-"libero_serial_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"}
+GPU=${GPU:-0}
+SUITES=${SUITES:-"libero_spatial libero_object libero_goal libero_10"}
+EPISODES=${EPISODES:-20}       # per task; 10 tasks x 20 = the official 200 denominator
+MAX_TASKS=${MAX_TASKS:-0}      # 0 = all 10 tasks of the suite
+SEED=${SEED:-42}
+MUJOCO_GL=${MUJOCO_GL:-egl}    # osmesa in the YAMLs; egl where osmesa is not installed
+
+export PYTHONPATH="$LOONGFORGE_PATH:$LOONGFORGE_PATH/ops/cuda_source/gr00t_n1_7_op:${PYTHONPATH:-}"
+export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
+export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU"
+# The policy server is a child process and inherits these. COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH loads
+# the Qwen3-VL processor from disk instead of the gated HF repo.
+export COSMOS_LOCAL_PATH="$COSMOS_PATH"
+# LIBERO's benchmark/__init__.py torch.load()s its own vendored init_states
+# pickles without weights_only=False, which torch >= 2.6 rejects.
+export TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1
+# robosuite asserts MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID is listed in CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
+if [ "$MUJOCO_GL" = "egl" ]; then export MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=${MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID:-$GPU}; fi
+
+read -ra SUITE_ARR <<< "$SUITES"
+RUN_DIR="$OUT_ROOT/$RUN_TAG"
+mkdir -p "$RUN_DIR/configs"
+
+py() { "$BENCHMARK_PYTHON" -W ignore "$@"; }
+
+render_cfg() {   # render_cfg <template.yaml> <out.yaml> key.sub=value ...
+    py -c 'import sys, yaml
+src, dst, *items = sys.argv[1:]
+cfg = yaml.safe_load(open(src))
+for item in items:
+    key, value = item.split("=", 1)
+    *parents, leaf = key.split(".")
+    node = cfg
+    for name in parents: node = node.setdefault(name, {})
+    node[leaf] = yaml.safe_load(value)
+yaml.safe_dump(cfg, open(dst, "w"), sort_keys=False)' "$@"
+}
+
+# LIBERO reads ${LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH:-~/.libero}/config.yaml on import and, when it
+# is missing, asks on stdin whether to use a custom dataset path -- EOFError in a
+# non-interactive run. Answer "n" once so LIBERO writes its default config, with
+# paths resolved from the LIBERO package installed in BENCHMARK_PYTHON.
+libero_cfg="${LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH:-$HOME/.libero}/config.yaml"
+if [ ! -f "$libero_cfg" ]; then
+    echo "Creating LIBERO default config: $libero_cfg"
+    echo n | "$BENCHMARK_PYTHON" -W ignore -c "import libero.libero" > /dev/null
+    [ -f "$libero_cfg" ] || { echo "ERROR: failed to create $libero_cfg" >&2; exit 1; }
+fi
+
+for suite in "${SUITE_ARR[@]}"; do
+    echo "===== $suite ====="
+    short=${suite#libero_}
+    ckpt=${CKPT_PATH//\{suite\}/$short}
+    stats=${STATS_PATH//\{suite\}/$short}
+    cfg="$RUN_DIR/configs/$suite.yaml"      # fixed YAML + runtime-injected paths
+    sdir="$RUN_DIR/$suite"
+    mkdir -p "$sdir"
+    [ -e "$ckpt" ] || { echo "ERROR: checkpoint not found: $ckpt" >&2; exit 1; }
+    [ -f "$stats" ] || { echo "ERROR: statistics not found: $stats" >&2; exit 1; }
+    render_cfg "$CONFIG_DIR/$suite.yaml" "$cfg" \
+        "benchmark.max_tasks=$MAX_TASKS" "benchmark.episodes_per_task=$EPISODES" \
+        "model.base_model_path=$COSMOS_PATH" "model.model_name=$COSMOS_PATH" \
+        "server.python=$SERVER_PY" "server.log=$sdir/policy_server.log" \
+        "server.ckpt_path=$ckpt" "server.dataset_statistics_path=$stats" \
+        "server.loongforge_root=$LOONGFORGE_PATH" \
+        "env.eval_root=$LOONGFORGE_PATH/loongforge/embodied/eval" \
+        "env.mujoco_gl=$MUJOCO_GL" "env.pyopengl_platform=$MUJOCO_GL" \
+        "run.output_dir=$sdir" "run.seed=$SEED"
+    "$BENCHMARK_PYTHON" -m loongforge.embodied.eval.orchestrator.run --config "$cfg" \
+        > "$sdir/eval.log" 2>&1 \
+        || { echo "ERROR: $suite failed, see $sdir/eval.log" >&2; exit 1; }
+    echo "  done: $(find "$sdir/gr00t_official" -name suite_summary.csv | head -n1)"
+done
+
+echo "===== Summary ====="
+py - "$RUN_DIR" "$EPISODES" "${SUITE_ARR[@]}" <<'PY' | tee "$RUN_DIR/summary.txt"
+import json, pathlib, sys
+run_dir, n, suites = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3:]
+w = max(len(s) for s in suites)
+rates = []
+for s in suites:
+    runs = sorted((run_dir / s / "gr00t_official").glob("*/tasks.jsonl"))
+    if len(runs) != 1:
+        raise SystemExit(f"INVALID: {s} has {len(runs)} gr00t_official runs (expected 1)")
+    tasks = [json.loads(l) for l in runs[0].read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
+    bad = [t["task_id"] for t in tasks if t["status"] != "OK" or t["n_episodes"] != n]
+    if bad:
+        raise SystemExit(f"INVALID: {s} tasks {bad} failed or lack {n} episodes")
+    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in (runs[0].parent / "results.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
+    ok = sum(int(r["success"]) for r in rows)
+    rates.append(ok / len(rows))
+    print(f"{s:<{w}}  {ok}/{len(rows)}  {ok / len(rows):.2%}")
+print(f"{'MACRO_AVERAGE':<{w}}  {sum(rates) / len(rates):.2%}")
+PY
+echo "===== Done: $RUN_DIR ====="

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+#
+# Public: GR00T-N1.7 SimplerEnv WidowX (Bridge) task-success, serial evaluation of
+# the 7 official Bridge tasks x EPISODES episodes.
+#
+# - Each task YAML ($CONFIG_DIR/<task>.yaml) holds only the fixed eval protocol plus
+#   the eval protocol; the machine/artifact paths below are injected at runtime,

+#   CKPT_PATH=/path/to/checkpoint bash run_simplerenv_bridge_eval.sh             # another checkpoint
+set -euo pipefail

+COSMOS_PATH=${COSMOS_PATH:-"/path/to/gr00t/Cosmos-Reason2-2B"}

+#!/usr/bin/env python
+# Copyright 2026 The LoongForge Authors.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""
+Generate meta/stats.json for LeRobot datasets (standalone version of gr00t/data/stats.py).
+
+Usage:
+    python gen_stats.py <dataset_path> [<dataset_path> ...]
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+from tqdm import tqdm
+
+
+DATA_GLOB = "data/*/*.parquet"
+INFO_FILENAME = "meta/info.json"
+STATS_FILENAME = "meta/stats.json"
+
+
+def compute_stats(dataset_path: Path, num_workers: int = 32) -> dict:
+    with open(dataset_path / INFO_FILENAME, "r") as f:
+        le_features = json.load(f)["features"]
+    features = [f for f in le_features if "float" in le_features[f]["dtype"]]
+
+    parquet_paths = sorted(dataset_path.glob(DATA_GLOB))
+    # Files are small and reads are latency-bound on network storage, so read concurrently.
+    # executor.map preserves input order, so the result matches a sequential read.
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(num_workers) as executor:
+        dfs = list(
+            tqdm(
+                executor.map(lambda p: pd.read_parquet(p, columns=features), parquet_paths),
+                total=len(parquet_paths),
+                desc="Loading parquet",
+            )
+        )
+    df = pd.concat(dfs, axis=0)
+
+    stats = {}
+    for feature in features:
+        print(f"Computing statistics for {feature}...")
+        data = np.vstack([np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float32) for x in df[feature]])
+        stats[feature] = dict(
+            mean=np.mean(data, axis=0).tolist(),
+            std=np.std(data, axis=0).tolist(),
+            min=np.min(data, axis=0).tolist(),
+            max=np.max(data, axis=0).tolist(),
+            q01=np.quantile(data, 0.01, axis=0).tolist(),
+            q99=np.quantile(data, 0.99, axis=0).tolist(),
+        )
+    return stats
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawTextHelpFormatter)
+    parser.add_argument("dataset_paths", nargs="+", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-workers", type=int, default=32, help="Threads for reading parquet files")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    for dataset_path in args.dataset_paths:
+        print(f"Generating stats for {dataset_path}")
+        stats = compute_stats(dataset_path, args.num_workers)
+        with open(dataset_path / STATS_FILENAME, "w") as f:
+            json.dump(stats, f, indent=4)
+        print(f"Saved {dataset_path / STATS_FILENAME}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Copyright 2026 The LoongForge Authors.
